text:
mara: Customer hit a 413 on /v1/rerank this morning, says "Request Entity Too Large" but the error doesn't indicate which part (query vs docs). attaching redacted payload.

lee: can you paste the exact error body and request-id? we'll need that for logs.

mara: request-id: req_01GkZxL9. Error body returned: "413 Payload Too Large". Customer payload (redacted):
```
{
  "query": "<user long search query — ~18k chars truncated for privacy>",
  "documents": ["doc1...", "doc2...", "doc3...", /* ~650 docs, many multi-kb */]
}
```

antoine: that is a lot of docs. our docs cap for rerank is a soft ceiling to keep tokenization predictable. if both query and doc lengths are large you hit the combined input token limit. do we have a clearer error code for "query too long" vs "docs too many/too long"?

sam: looking at the logs for req_01GkZxL9 — backend returned internal 413 with internal code `input_exceeded_max_tokens`. currently we surface generic 413. stack trace indicates tokenization failed when building the concatenated rerank inputs (query + doc snippets). can repro locally with their payload.

mara: customer wants guidance only — they tried chunking and still hit it. asked why message doesn't say which element caused it.

sam: short-term: we can tell them to reduce docs count to <200 or trim per-doc length to <1k characters, and prefilter with embeddings. long-term: eng should make the 413 include a structured reason (e.g., `query_too_long`, `docs_too_many`, `docs_token_overflow`) and return token counts so users can programmatically detect it.

antoine: +1 on structured reasons. UX suggestion: include `max_allowed_tokens` and `payload_tokens` in the error body so clients can auto-chunk. also include a sample chunking snippet in the docs.

lee: I replied to the customer with a reproducible workaround: run a quick token estimate before calling rerank (link to our helper snippet) and fallback to embedding-prefilter when doccount>250. asked them to confirm if they can share a minimal repro we can use to file a formal bug.

mara: customer sent a smaller repro (attached) — still fails. I've uploaded the repro to /mnt/scratch/repro_req_01GkZxL9.json and pinged @sam to take a look.

deploy-bot: started job build/repro-local-1719801234 (containerized replay). status: running.

sam: repro runs. root cause: we concatenate doc passages without enforcing an intermediate max per-rerank-request token guard in the API layer — the runtime raises the 413 but doesn't annotate which side exceeded. patch idea: validate tokens(client-side estimate) in API gateway and map runtime codes to structured error payloads.

mara: can you put a short PR description and a suggested error schema here so I can escalate to product for a UX change? customer is worried about ambiguous errors breaking automated retries.

sam: PR draft summary: "rerank: surface structured 413 errors with reason codes and token counters". Example error body:
```
HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large
{
  "error": "payload_too_large",
  "reason": "docs_tokens_exceeded",
  "payload_tokens": 312480,
  "max_allowed_tokens": 300000,
  "request_id": "req_01GkZxL9"
}
```

antoine: LGTM. also add guidance in docs for progressive prefiltering: 1) embed top-K, 2) rerank only top N, 3) fall back to heuristic title-only rerank for extreme cases.

mara: I'll send the workaround and ETA to the customer. marking internal follow-up with product + eng on UX change. closing thread once product ack. :white_check_mark:
